summary: Answer a Codex approval from st only when its request was seen, and each queued request in turn

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Approval waits now name their request kind (commandExecution, fileChange, permissions) as the harness observation's reason; a wait known only from the thread flag keeps waitingOnApproval and is answered in the terminal. A seat whose Codex driver predates this build keeps publishing waitingOnApproval, so its approvals are answered in the terminal until it restarts.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions, client re-pairing or configuration changes required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
